name: Vittoria Marrelli
bioAdditions: Vittoria Marrello was a real person, but she was the wife of Francesco Gabriele Fiorillo, not of Domenico. Her sons Gabriele (d. 1839, aged 7), Angelo (c.1824-1912) and Lorenzo (c.1835-1915) are all recorded as children of Francesco Fiorillo and Vittoria Marrello (S2, S3). Carmine's own 1840 marriage, made during his mother's lifetime, names her as Maria Marrelli (S1). The 1860 death act and burial (S4) evidently substituted the aunt's name. Recommendation: detach Vittoria from John's line and use Maria Marrello (I282824815353) as Carmine's mother.

openQuestionsResolved.question: Her parents and origin; Carmine's marriage act
openQuestionsResolved.answer: Carmine's civil marriage (1 Mar 1840, act 3) names his mother as Maria Marrelli, not Vittoria. Vittoria Marrello was the wife of Francesco Gabriele Fiorillo.
